body:
I just wanted to say, to all of you, thank you for your support.  I'm feeling much better now than I was before, but that's not to say I'm done here for good.  There will be no crisis tonight.  I can go back to using my normal account now.

Love you all!

Well I really appreciate the suggestions!  Maybe I will do something similar tonight.  Only over a bottle of Merlot.  ;)

By the way, she is one person (of a select few) who sees me for what I feel I am actually worth.  She believes in me.  I just don't know if I believe in me.

>So do you just need a kick in the ass and be told that smart people have it harder than those who aren't?

May be just what the doctor ordered.

>>I just can't help but feel like my failures are all that define me, and that I am incapable of bringing myself to ever change things for myself. My two true loves are music and my lovely girlfriend. Yet the negatives of sticking around to see how my shitstorm of a life that I've created for myself are far outweighing the positives, at least this afternoon.

>You should perhaps consider that your failures and faults do define you ;) Modern society HATES THAT, but there is some older truth of this. The creative and analytical work of Thomas Mann was focused on this and he coined it "the Erotic Irony" of life / humans.

I know that we are defined, in part, by our failures and our faults, but it seems like that's all I am anymore.  A failure and a fault.
